sentences.vi: Một lần nữa cô thở dài thườn thượt.

sentences.en: Once into the woods, she began to relax.

sentences.en: I expect you to repay me once it's sold.

sentences.en: All at once a light flashed out from the tower.

sentences.en: Once again he had caught her napping.

sentences.en: But once her father was like that.
sentences.vi: Nhưng một khi cha cô đã như vậy.

sentences.en: Princess Ozma once brought him to life with a witch-powder, when she was a boy.

sentences.en: Once she was settled in the seat, he shut the door and walked around the car to the driver's side.
sentences.vi: Khi cô đã ổn định chỗ ngồi, anh đóng cửa lại và đi vòng quanh xe về phía tài xế.
